title: Healthy Kids Steady-Payer Reward
content:
# Healthy Kids Steady-Payer Reward

Terms for families paying a CHIP premium on a Medicaid Managed Care Membership.

## Term

The Healthy Kids steady-payer reward follows how the family paid its premiums: where at least the steady-payer minimum of premium payments were posted in the reward look-back months through the member portal and the phone line together, with portal payments at least as many as phone payments, the reward is the portal steady-payer amount; where that many were posted through those two channels with phone payments outnumbering portal payments, the reward is the phone steady-payer amount; otherwise there is no steady-payer reward.

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Steady-payer minimum | 6 premium payments |
| Reward look-back | the 12 months before the review date |
| Portal steady-payer amount | $1.50 |
| Phone steady-payer amount | $0.75 |

The reward is one of the Healthy Kids rewards credited on the premium month the family pays.

## Counting the payments

- Only premium payments posted in the 12 months before the review date count.
- Only payments made through the member portal and through the phone payment line count toward the 6; a payment by mailed check or money order is not one of them.
- Portal payments and phone payments are then compared: portal payments at least as many as phone payments, or phone payments outnumbering portal payments.

## Tiers

| Portal and phone payments together | Comparison | Reward |
|---|---|---|
| 6 or more | portal at least as many as phone | $1.50 |
| 6 or more | phone more than portal | $0.75 |
| 5 or fewer | any | none |

## Cases (hypothetical)

1. *Hypothetical:* 3 portal and 3 phone payments in the look-back: 6 together, portal equal to phone, so $1.50.
2. *Hypothetical:* 2 portal and 5 phone payments: 7 together, phone more than portal, so $0.75.
3. *Hypothetical:* 4 portal payments, 1 phone payment and 3 mailed checks: 5 through the portal and phone line together, so there is no steady-payer reward.
